lines.zh: 壳底擦着末地石，半格半格挪
lines.en: My rim scrapes end stone, half a block per shuffle.

lines.zh: 我不该会走，是附身的巨灵在拖
lines.en: I was not meant to walk; the possessing spirit drags me.

lines.zh: 飘起一寸，又沉回原来的位置
lines.en: I drift up an inch, then sink back to the same spot.

lines.zh: 借来的身体，走起来像还债
lines.en: A borrowed body walks like an unpaid debt.

lines.zh: 紫颂果的甜味在前头牵着我
lines.en: The sweetness of chorus fruit pulls me forward.

lines.zh: 壳太沉，路太长，我慢慢来
lines.en: The shell is heavy, the road is long; I go slowly.

lines.zh: 每挪一步，壳里就有人笑一声
lines.en: Each shuffle, someone laughs inside my shell.

lines.zh: 我不是潜影贝，只借了它的壳
lines.en: I am no shulker; I only borrowed its shell.

lines.zh: 方块的记忆还压在我脚底
lines.en: The memory of being a block still weighs on me.

lines.zh: 挪进阴影，别让末地光看见我
lines.en: Slip into the shade before the End light sees me.

lines.zh: 这份重量是别人的，走得很别扭
lines.en: This weight is another's; walking feels all wrong.

lines.zh: 半格，再半格，末地没有尽头
lines.en: Half a block, then half again; the End never ends.

lines.zh: 壳合上，里面安静得发闷
lines.en: Shell closed, the inside is quiet and stifling.

lines.zh: 我数自己的呼吸，可我没有肺
lines.en: I count my breaths, though I have no lungs.

lines.zh: 末地的风撞在壳上，像敲门
lines.en: End wind knocks against my shell like a visitor.

lines.zh: 巨灵在壳里翻了个身，我晃一下
lines.en: The spirit rolls over inside and my shell tilts.

lines.zh: 紫颂果的核卡在壳缝里发甜
lines.en: A chorus seed sweetens where it stuck in my seam.

lines.zh: 我不睡，潜影贝本来也不睡
lines.en: I do not sleep; shulkers never really did.

lines.zh: 壳上那道旧裂，是召唤时留下的
lines.en: That old crack came from the ritual that made me.

lines.zh: 我试着缩回方块，缩不回去了
lines.en: I try to shrink back into a block; it will not take me.

lines.zh: 有人在壳外踱步，我不开
lines.en: Someone paces outside; I keep the shell shut.

lines.zh: 附身的印记在壳内壁发烫
lines.en: The possession mark burns on my inner shell.

lines.zh: 我听得见紫颂树抽芽的声音
lines.en: I can hear chorus trees budding far away.

lines.zh: 安静久了，巨灵开始不耐烦
lines.en: Idle too long, the spirit grows impatient.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，我的壳已经张开
lines.en: You stand too close; my shell is already opening.

lines.zh: 你脸上有末地没有的东西，热气
lines.en: You have something the End lacks: warmth.

lines.zh: 我在看你的手，不是你的眼睛
lines.en: I am watching your hands, not your eyes.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进我的壳缝里了
lines.en: Your shadow fell into the gap of my shell.

lines.zh: 你也会被附身吗，还是只路过
lines.en: Will you be possessed too, or only passing?

lines.zh: 别动，我在闻你手上的末地尘
lines.en: Hold still; I am smelling End dust on you.

lines.zh: 巨灵说它认识你，我不信
lines.en: The spirit says it knows you; I doubt it.

lines.zh: 你身上有紫颂果的汁水
lines.en: You carry the juice of chorus fruit on you.

lines.zh: 我看你时，壳里那颗心在响
lines.en: When I look at you, the heart in my shell thumps.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛没有末地人的灰
lines.en: Your eyes lack the gray of End folk.

lines.zh: 抬头，我想看清你帽子底下
lines.en: Look up; I want to see under your hood.

lines.zh: 你看我的壳，我看你的手
lines.en: You study my shell; I study your hands.

lines.zh: 别把手伸过来，壳会咬
lines.en: Do not reach in; the shell bites.

lines.zh: 末地很少来客，我多看你几眼
lines.en: The End rarely has guests; I stare a while.

lines.zh: 壳裂了，里面的巨灵在叫
lines.en: The shell cracked, and the spirit inside is screaming.

lines.zh: 疼是别人的，我替它挨
lines.en: The pain is another's; I take it for him.

lines.zh: 你打碎的只是一层壳
lines.en: You only broke a layer of shell.

lines.zh: 这一刀不深，够我记住你
lines.en: A shallow cut, deep enough to remember you.

lines.zh: 别停手，我想看看自己还剩多少
lines.en: Do not stop; I want to see what is left of me.

lines.zh: 紫颂果从我壳里滚出去了
lines.en: A chorus fruit rolled out of my shell.

lines.zh: 附身的东西也会痛，很奇怪吧
lines.en: Possessed things hurt too; strange, is it not?

lines.zh: 我的壳片掉在地上，还在动
lines.en: My shell shard fell and it is still moving.

lines.zh: 再打，巨灵就要自己出来了
lines.en: Hit again and the spirit will come out itself.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，壳口却张得更大
lines.en: I stepped back, but my shell opened wider.

lines.zh: 你举着紫颂果，我不为食物动弹
lines.en: You wave chorus fruit; food will not move me.

lines.zh: 我早就不吃东西了，只记得甜味
lines.en: I stopped eating long ago; only the sweetness stays.

lines.zh: 果子留着，你的手更值得看
lines.en: Keep the fruit; your hand is more interesting.

lines.zh: 附身之后，连饥饿都换了主人
lines.en: After possession, even hunger changed owners.

lines.zh: 别拿食物换我，契约已经写好了
lines.en: Do not trade food for me; the contract is written.

lines.zh: 我想尝的不是果肉，是你心跳
lines.en: What I want is not fruit but your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 紫颂果滚到脚边，我没去捡
lines.en: A chorus fruit rolled to my feet; I left it.

lines.zh: 甜味勾不起壳里那个东西
lines.en: Sweetness cannot stir the thing inside my shell.

lines.zh: 紫颂果塞进壳口，我也不走
lines.en: Stuff chorus fruit in my shell; I still will not go.

lines.zh: 食物的味道太淡，仪式太浓
lines.en: Food tastes thin; the ritual still tastes strong.

lines.zh: 别推，壳边会刮破你的皮
lines.en: Do not shove; my rim will cut your skin.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我晃了很久才稳
lines.en: One bump and I wobble a long while.

lines.zh: 你的肩碰到壳，壳里传来回音
lines.en: Your shoulder hits my shell and an echo answers.

lines.zh: 我不是故意挡路，是挪不快
lines.en: I do not block you on purpose; I just move slowly.

lines.zh: 壳被撞开一条缝，快走开
lines.en: The impact cracked my shell; step back now.

lines.zh: 你再挤，巨灵会当成挑衅
lines.en: Push again and the spirit takes it as a challenge.

lines.zh: 末地石太滑，我顺着撞上你
lines.en: End stone is slick; I slid straight into you.

lines.zh: 碰到我的人，活不到第二次
lines.en: Those who bump me rarely manage a second time.

lines.zh: 壳硬，你的骨头会先响
lines.en: My shell is hard; your bones will crack first.

lines.zh: 让开半步，我就能过去
lines.en: Step aside half a block and I can pass.

lines.zh: 我生不出后代，仪式只造了我一个
lines.en: I breed nothing; the ritual made only me.

lines.zh: 找别的潜影贝去吧，我不算完整
lines.en: Find another shulker; I am not whole.

lines.zh: 附身的东西不交配，只吞噬
lines.en: Possessed things do not mate; they consume.

lines.zh: 壳里没有卵，只有一口借来的气
lines.en: No eggs in my shell, only borrowed breath.

lines.zh: 别把同伴推给我，我不认亲缘
lines.en: Do not push a mate at me; I know no kin.

lines.zh: 两个被附身的，只会互相撕壳
lines.en: Two possessed ones would only tear each other's shells.

lines.zh: 繁殖是活物的权利，我没有
lines.en: Breeding is a living creature's right; I lack it.

lines.zh: 我身后空空的，没有小潜影贝
lines.en: Behind me is empty; no little shulkers follow.

lines.zh: 这份孤独是五芒星阵画出来的
lines.en: This loneliness was drawn by a pentacle.

lines.zh: 别替我找伴，壳会替我说不
lines.en: Do not find me a mate; my shell will refuse.

lines.zh: 把东西放地上，我自己挪过去
lines.en: Leave it on the ground; I will shuffle over.

lines.zh: 我捡不起来，爪子早没了
lines.en: I cannot pick it up; my claws are gone.

lines.zh: 紫颂果给我，壳会替我收好
lines.en: Give me the chorus fruit; the shell will store it.

lines.zh: 捡到的东西都掉在壳底了
lines.en: Whatever I grab falls to the bottom of my shell.

lines.zh: 我不需要工具，我需要有人靠近
lines.en: I need no tools; I need someone to come near.

lines.zh: 让开，你踩着我正要捡的壳片
lines.en: Move; you stand on a shard I wanted.

lines.zh: 附身的手不灵活，掉了三次
lines.en: Possessed hands are clumsy; I dropped it three times.

lines.zh: 别给我，我不欠你什么
lines.en: Do not hand it to me; I owe you nothing.

lines.zh: 我捡东西只是想摸一摸活气
lines.en: I pick things up only to feel something alive.

lines.zh: 壳口一合，东西就归我了
lines.en: The shell shuts and the thing is mine.

lines.zh: 你的影子太近，我标记你了
lines.en: Your shadow is too near; I have marked you.

lines.zh: 壳张开的时候，就别再靠近
lines.en: When the shell opens, come no closer.

lines.zh: 巨灵说了你的名字，很难听
lines.en: The spirit said your name; it sounds ugly.

lines.zh: 我看见你手上的镐了，先收起来
lines.en: I see the pick in your hand; put it away.

lines.zh: 末地欢迎客人，用壳子弹
lines.en: The End welcomes guests with shell bullets.

lines.zh: 你不是末地人，但你会浮起来
lines.en: You are no End native, but you will float.

lines.zh: 我锁定了你的呼吸声
lines.en: I have locked onto the sound of your breathing.

lines.zh: 别跑，壳口已经对准你了
lines.en: Do not run; the shell mouth is already on you.

lines.zh: 这次附身，正缺一个活靶
lines.en: This possession is short one living target.

lines.zh: 你走进了我的半格范围
lines.en: You stepped inside my half-block reach.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你就得浮空
lines.en: I count to three, and then you float.

lines.zh: 视线一碰上，就不用客气
lines.en: Once our eyes meet, courtesy is over.

lines.zh: 巨灵饿了，它指了你
lines.en: The spirit is hungry and it pointed at you.

lines.zh: 我不恨你，只是被指了方向
lines.en: I bear you no hate; I was simply aimed.

lines.zh: 壳缝里那点紫光在跟着你转
lines.en: The violet light in my seam follows you.

lines.zh: 慢慢移，别让我猜
lines.en: Move slowly and do not make me guess.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我就多追半格
lines.en: Every step you retreat, I gain half a block.

lines.zh: 飘浮的弹道已经算好落点
lines.en: The floating arc already has its landing point.

lines.zh: 别以为躲在方块后面我就看不见
lines.en: Do not think a block hides you from me.

lines.zh: 我看着你，壳里在数拍子
lines.en: I watch you while something in my shell keeps time.

lines.zh: 你喘气的节奏出卖了你
lines.en: The rhythm of your breathing gives you away.

lines.zh: 再绕，我就把这条走廊封住
lines.en: Circle again and I will seal this corridor.

lines.zh: 末地这么大，我偏偏盯着你
lines.en: The End is vast, yet I stare only at you.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，末地人也怕浮空
lines.en: Your hand shakes; even End folk fear floating.

lines.zh: 贴近一点，我的射程刚好在这里
lines.en: Closer now; my range ends right here.

lines.zh: 你背后的紫颂树挡不住子弹
lines.en: The chorus tree behind you will not stop a bullet.

lines.zh: 别停，停下的都成了壳片
lines.en: Do not stop; the ones who stop become shell shards.

lines.zh: 我在等你踏错那半格
lines.en: I wait for you to misjudge that half block.

lines.zh: 壳盖抬起一指宽，我在看你
lines.en: My shell lifts a finger's width; I am watching you.

lines.zh: 吃一发，然后慢慢飘起来
lines.en: Take one, then drift slowly upward.

lines.zh: 壳子弹擦过你的肩，浮力来了
lines.en: The bullet grazed your shoulder; here comes the lift.

lines.zh: 别抓壳，壳边是刀刃
lines.en: Do not grab the shell; its rim is a blade.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，你就在天花板上了
lines.en: One shove from me and you are on the ceiling.

lines.zh: 紫颂果的甜，你尝到了吗
lines.en: Did you taste the sweetness of chorus fruit?

lines.zh: 这一击是巨灵借我的手打的
lines.en: The spirit threw this blow through my hand.

lines.zh: 飘起来，再摔下去，不用第二发
lines.en: Up, then down; no second shot needed.

lines.zh: 你挡得住壳，挡不住浮空
lines.en: You can block my shell, not the floating.

lines.zh: 我的力气小，落点很准
lines.en: My strength is small; my aim is exact.

lines.zh: 你落地的时候，我再补一击
lines.en: When you land, I will add one more.

lines.zh: 别躲，末地没有天花板给你抓
lines.en: Do not dodge; the End has no ceiling to grab.

lines.zh: 孱弱也能杀人，只要够耐心
lines.en: Weakness kills too, given patience.

lines.zh: 五芒星亮过，我就站在这里了
lines.en: The pentacle flared, and here I stand.

lines.zh: 有人用方块的生命把我换来
lines.en: Someone traded a block's life for mine.

lines.zh: 召唤我的人以为能拴住我
lines.en: My summoner thought a leash would hold me.

lines.zh: 紫颂果的味道是我落地时闻到的
lines.en: Chorus fruit is the first thing I smelled here.

lines.zh: 我不是生出来的，是画出来的
lines.en: I was not born; I was drawn.

lines.zh: 仪式缺一笔，我就多一分脾气
lines.en: The ritual missed a stroke, so I gained a temper.

lines.zh: 壳是借的，命也是借的
lines.en: The shell is borrowed, and so is the life.

lines.zh: 我从末地的石缝里被拽出来
lines.en: I was hauled out of a crack in End stone.

lines.zh: 第一眼看见的是地上的粉笔线
lines.en: The first thing I saw was chalk on the floor.

lines.zh: 别问我的名字，仪式没给我取
lines.en: Do not ask my name; the ritual gave none.

lines.zh: 刚被附身时，我还想缩回方块
lines.en: Right after possession I still tried to shrink back.

lines.zh: 末地多了我一个，少了半块石
lines.en: The End gained me and lost half a block.

lines.zh: 我带着紫颂果来，也带着壳
lines.en: I brought chorus fruit, and I brought the shell.

lines.zh: 末地没有火，你从哪带来的
lines.en: The End has no fire; where did you bring that from?

lines.zh: 潜影贝不该落地，我却落地了
lines.en: A shulker should never land, yet I landed.

lines.zh: 末地没有水，你在淹一个壳
lines.en: There is no water here; you are drowning a shell.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀开壳，巨灵看见了光
lines.en: The blast pried my shell open and the spirit saw light.

lines.zh: 箭插在壳上，像一根没用的刺
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shell like a useless thorn.

lines.zh: 魔法打的是壳里那个东西，不是我
lines.en: Your magic struck the thing in my shell, not me.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿的是壳里的它
lines.en: I do not eat; the hunger belongs to what is inside.

lines.zh: 雷劈开末地石，也劈开我的壳
lines.en: Lightning split the End stone, and split my shell.

lines.zh: 往下掉的时候，壳里终于安静了
lines.en: Falling into the void, my shell finally went quiet.
